plugins.name: marcora
plugins.description: Marcora — the context layer for GTM teams. Bundles the hosted Marcora MCP server with its companion skill (marcora-mcp) so your AI assistant can create on-brand marketing content, manage brand context and blueprints, organize projects, plan and produce content on the plans board with playbooks, and build reusable workflows.

skills.name: marcora-mcp
skills.description: Use this skill BEFORE calling any Marcora MCP tool (the `mcp__marcora*` family — create_content, add_context, create_plan, produce_plan, create_workflow, etc.) and whenever a request involves Marcora, including any `marcora.ai` URL the user pastes (e.g. an `app.marcora.ai` library or canvas link). It maps the Marcora tools to the standard product-marketing workflows — creating, editing, and sharing content; generating from blueprints; managing projects and briefs; adding reference context; browsing the Blueprint Exchange; answering what's in the library; managing content plans and playbooks; and building reusable, multi-step workflows — and applies Marcora's domain rules so the right artifact lands in the right place. Triggers on Marcora, blueprints, projects, briefs, the Reference Library, Brand Foundation, Targeting Dimensions, Context Collections, content plans, playbooks, and workflow cues ("recurring", "automate this", "make this reusable") — even when the user doesn't say "Marcora.
headings: Starting from a Marcora URL or ID
Workflow 2 — Set or change a project brief
Working inside a project — read the brief first
Workflow 3 — Add reference context to the user's library
Workflow 5 — Find existing context / Q&A / ideation
Workflow 6 — Ground a document against the library
Signals the user wants a workflow
